name: Zmey Gorynych

crownPassive.name: Three heads
crownPassive.text: His attack becomes three separate attacks of 1 damage each, at three random enemy cards anywhere on the board. If there are fewer than three, a card can be hit more than once.

bond.name: Rus' kin
bond.text: Each head deals +1 damage for each other Rus' hero you field.

actions.name: Attack
actions.text: Standard attack: damage equal to Attack.

rules: Each head is its own attack: Guard and Vulnerable apply to each hit.
Guinevere's Queen's peace doesn't stop him.
